items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Art Blakey went in January—his group, [Jazz] Messengers—and we went there in March.

ctx.x: I don‟t think we ever played a club in those days, you know, they were all concerts. In sixty, ‟61, uh … Art Blakey went in January—his group, [Jazz] Messengers—and we went there in March. So, but after that, Art Blakey, every year, he would go to Japan, and that was the beginning of the American players going, [to] start going to Japan.
